resolvedAttempts.reason: Initial focused run found two fixture assumptions: sealed host requires its sealed state as well as the physical seal before refreshing; bouncing the GR returns its attached Jeri to hand, which is movement rather than a destruction draw. Corrected fixture assertions; original failure log retained.
